::: {.obsidian-board-minutes}
:::

Record the opening: who chaired, who attended, who sent apologies,
and whether a quorum was present.

# Minutes of the previous meeting

Record the approval of the previous minutes and any matters
arising.

# Agenda items

Record each agenda item in turn. For each, note the discussion and
the decision.

# Resolutions

List the resolutions passed. Give each a number and state the
voting: for, against, and abstentions.

# Action items

List the actions with their owners and due dates. Use a table.

# Any other business

Record anything raised outside the agenda.

# Close

Record the time of close and the date of the next meeting.
